readme.run: Correct susceptibility distortion in a DWI series with SyN-SDC
notes: Runs the web app's fieldmap-less SyN-SDC, a port of sdcflows 2.17.1, on the CPU:
MindGrab brain masks, ANTs registrations to the T1w of the same session in
WebAssembly, the B-spline field fit and the unwarp of every volume. It writes the
corrected series with its .bval, .bvec and .json, the field in Hz, its
coefficients, the displacement field and the brain mask.
The .bval, .bvec and .json beside the series with the same name are used; the
sidecar must give PhaseEncodingDirection and a readout time, or use --pe-dir
A full-brain series takes about 1.5 to 2 hours and up to 6.5 GB of memory. The
distortion prior and its notices are included, so no network connection is
required. Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with dcm2niix first, or use the
It ports sdcflows 2.17.1 (NiPreps, Apache-2.0). The prior is the distortion
atlas of Treiber JM, White NS, Steed TC, et al. Characterization and correction of
geometric distortions in 814 diffusion weighted images. PLoS ONE.
